name: mirakl-mcp
description: Mirakl-powered marketplaces (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_mirakl_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MIRAKL_API_KEY
platform_mcp_mirakl_api_key.description: Shop API key generated in the marketplace's Mirakl seller back office (user menu > API key > Generate); sent verbatim as the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

platform_mcp_mirakl_instance_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MIRAKL_INSTANCE_HOST
platform_mcp_mirakl_instance_host.description: Host of your marketplace's Mirakl instance without scheme, e.g. marketplace.example.com or <operator>.mirakl.net (the operator gives it with the API key); every call goes to https://<instance_host>/api/...

platform_mcp_mirakl_shop_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MIRAKL_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_mirakl_shop_id.description: Numeric shop id, only when your API key's user has access to several shops (sent as ?shop_id= on every call; the default shop is used otherwise).

tools.name: me
tools.description: A01 GET /api/account returns the shop {shop_id, shop_name, shop_state, currency_iso_code, channels, contact_informations, ...}. Mirakl's documented maximum usage for A01 is once per day.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: OR11 GET /api/orders?order_state_codes&start_date(ISO-8601 creation date)&offset&max(default 10, max 100). `status` is a comma-separated list of STAGING|WAITING_ACCEPTANCE|WAITING_DEBIT|WAITING_DEBIT_PAYMENT|SHIPPING|SHIPPED|TO_COLLECT|RECEIVED|CLOSED|REFUSED|CANCELED. Returns {orders[], total_count}; the order lines, customer and shipping address are in raw.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: OR23 PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/tracking {carrier_code, tracking_number} records the carrier tracking of the order. `carrier` must be a carrier code registered on the marketplace (see CH11/SH21 carriers). Confirming the shipment itself is a separate call (OR24 PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/ship) that this tool does not make, so the order stays in SHIPPING until it is validated.
